edit.description: Route the afterCommit gate-context `configDir` rebase (:3404) through `computeStateRootRel` (:707) instead of a bare join.
Pin both branches of the rebase.

summary: Gate-context `configDir` rebase (src/Dispatcher.ts:3404) skips the escape check `computeStateRootRel` already performs, so a repo-external configDir rebases into a nonexistent path

per.section: The fix lands at the mechanism

tests: an afterCommit gate under a configDir relocated outside the repo receives that dir verbatim, not a path rebased onto the worktree
an afterCommit gate under an in-repo configDir (default, and relocated within the repo) still receives it rebased onto the worktree
acceptance: Both branches pinned; the escape test lives only in `computeStateRootRel`.
notes: `computeStateRootRel`'s doc enumerates three consumers as the shared home and claims none re-derives the check; :3404 is the fourth and re-derives half (join, no escape test). afterMerge is unaffected — cwd===repoRoot makes the rebase a no-op. win32 cross-drive is the same case: `relative` returns an absolute path, which the helper's `isAbsolute` catches. Measured: repoRoot=/r, cwd=/r/.flume/worktrees/x, configDir=/home/shared -> /r/.flume/shared.
